cohort: The study included 1,016 postpartum women from Kersa and Haramaya Health and Demographic Surveillance Sites in eastern Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum CMD was 23.84%, with poor social support, lower wealth index, obstetric complications, and cesarean delivery significantly associated with its occurrence.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be significantly associated with postpartum Common Mental Disorders (CMD).
cross-section timing: During the postpartum period, between 1 July 2021 and 28 February 2022.
